description: Saves an open user global library by name (from tia_global_libraries; exact name first, then ignoring case) and returns its name as {saved}. Serves after app 1.6.3 refuse a name that picks no single open USER library, nothing saved: an unknown name is 404 kind:"not_found"; a system or corporate library (read-only), or a name several user libraries match only ignoring case, is 409 kind:"conflict"; details.userLibraries / systemLibraries / corporateLibraries list the open libraries (up to 1.6.3: 200 {saved:<name>} even when nothing was saved — confirm the name with tia_global_libraries first). A user library opened read-only (tia_global_library_open with readWrite:false) cannot be saved: 409 kind:"conflict" with details.readOnly:true after app 1.6.3 (up to 1.6.3: 500 internal) — close it and open it again with readWrite:true to change and save it. Maps to POST /globallibraries/save {name}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
